# 07 codex probe -- does a plain `codex` invocation fail?  @ 2026-09-21T17:00 +0800
#
# Host: codex-cli 0.155.1 (/usr/bin/codex).  No CODEX_HOME env var is set, so the
# active config is ~/.codex/config.toml.
#
# SUMMARY (measured):
#   * plain `codex exec` DID fail before the fix: HTTP 404 on POST /responses.
#   * the failing URL came from base_url = "https://zjapi.com" (no /v1), NOT from
#     a local relay.  Nothing listens on 127.0.0.1:15722 (or :15721) on this host.
#   * `codex doctor` called that same broken endpoint "reachable (HTTP 200)":
#     a FALSE GREEN -- its reachability check accepts any HTTP status.
#   * adding "/v1" fixes it end-to-end (two successful calls, 14,425 tokens each).

## 2. Candidate fix verified with a command-line override ONLY (config.toml untouched)

  $ codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox read-only \
        -c model_providers.custom.base_url='"https://zjapi.com/v1"' \
        -c model_reasoning_effort='"low"' "Reply with exactly the two characters: OK"
  codex
  OK
  tokens used
  14,425
  exit=0

## 3. AFTER the file fix (one line in ~/.codex/config.toml; see 05_config_hygiene.txt)

  $ codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox read-only \
        -c model_reasoning_effort='"low"' "Reply with exactly the two characters: OK"
  codex
  OK
  tokens used
  14,425
  exit=0

  $ codex doctor          # 17:00, after the change
  Connectivity
    ✓ reachability active provider endpoints are reachable over HTTP
        reachability mode        API key auth
        custom API inference URL https://zjapi.com/v1/<redacted> reachable (HTTP 404)
        custom API route probe   https://zjapi.com/v1/<redacted> route exists (HTTP 401)

  NOTE: doctor still prints its "✓ ... reachable" line -- now next to an HTTP 404.
  The ✓/label carries no information; only the HTTP code does, and doctor's check
  does not distinguish 2xx from 4xx. Do not use `codex doctor` reachability as a
  functional probe (this is why the earlier "endpoint is reachable" reading of the
  broken config was a false green).

## 4. Reproduce from scratch

  # broken (404) -- restore the pre-fix line, then:
  cp ~/.codex/config.toml.a0d5-bak-20260921T165606 ~/.codex/config.toml
  cd /tmp/a0d5_codexcheck && codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox read-only \
      -c model_reasoning_effort='"low"' "Reply with exactly the two characters: OK"
  # working (exit 0, "OK", 14,425 tokens):
  cp ~/.codex/config.toml /tmp/cfg.bak && \
    sed -i 's|base_url = "https://zjapi.com"|base_url = "https://zjapi.com/v1"|' ~/.codex/config.toml
  # (or see the diff recorded in 05_config_hygiene.txt)
